l: REANO: Optimising Retrieval-Augmented Reader Models through Knowledge Graph Generation, REANO: Optimising Retrieval-Augmented Reader Models through Knowledge Graph Generation, Abstract
s: Open domain question answering (ODQA) uses knowledge from an external corpus to answer questions. The Fusion-in-Decoder (FiD) retrieval-augmented reader model independently encodes passages, overlooking semantic relationships between them. REANO enhances this model with a knowledge graph generator that generates knowledge graphs from passages and an answer predictor that generates answers from the passages and generated knowledge graphs. Across five ODQA datasets, REANO improves exact match scores by up to 2.7% on the EntityQuestion dataset, with an average improvement of 1.8%.
